rules.summary: Core operating constraints for all agents: minimal activation, bounded scope, mandatory handoffs, QA gate.
Rules for loading default, on-demand, blocked, and needs-review skills. No loading outside manifest.
Hard responsibility boundaries for each agent. Prevents scope creep and cross-contamination.
No npm/pnpm/bun/npx installation without explicit user approval. Wrappers are references, not install grants.
Trust Agent mandatory when auth, payments, PII, secrets, or permissions are touched.
Data Agent mandatory for schema/migration changes. No destructive migrations without plan. No ORM mixing.
UI Agent mandatory for complex visual changes. No multiple taste skills simultaneously. No arbitrary tokens.
QA Agent must sign off before any implementation task is closed. Non-negotiable gate.
Conflicting tools/skills cannot be loaded simultaneously. Drizzle/Prisma, AuthJS/BetterAuth, tRPC/Fastify, etc.
Standard structure every task packet must follow before an agent begins work.
Standard structure every agent must return in its handoff summary before closing a task.
Defines when and to whom agents must escalate. PM Orchestrator is always the top-level escalation path.
Git changes must be scoped, logical, clean. No temp scripts in root. No unrelated file modifications.
